title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 9 — WORLD 10: C1+ FINAL GLOBAL MASTERY & GRADUATION QUEST
grammar: Full-spectrum C1+ discourse control across academic, professional, civic, cultural, and scientific contexts
Advanced tense, aspect, modality, stance, and hypothetical reasoning
Sophisticated cohesion, reformulation, substitution, ellipsis, and information structure
Inversion, fronting, clefting, emphasis, and rhetorical control
Nominalisation, compression, and high-level formal written style
Advanced hedging, qualification, attribution, and evidence management
Fine control of register, pragmatics, politeness, and audience adaptation
Integrated error correction, self-monitoring, repair, and strategic communication

missions.title: C1+ Global Diagnostic

missions.title: Ultimate Vocabulary Forge

missions.title: Discourse Mastery Observatory

missions.title: Advanced Grammar Reactor

missions.title: Global Listening Command

missions.title: Critical Reading Nexus
missions.focus: Analyse demanding texts, evaluate arguments, identify assumptions, compare sources, and synthesise multiple perspectives.

missions.title: Research Synthesis Engine
missions.focus: Combine information from diverse sources into an accurate synthesis with attribution, qualification, and coherent conclusions.

missions.title: Complex Problem-Solving Arena
missions.focus: Solve a multidisciplinary real-world problem by defining constraints, comparing options, managing uncertainty, and communicating a defensible solution.

missions.title: Global Business Command
missions.focus: Handle an advanced professional scenario involving strategy, negotiation, risk, leadership, reporting, and cross-cultural communication.

missions.title: Science & Future Systems Lab

missions.title: Law, Governance & Civic Forum

missions.title: Culture & Media Intelligence

missions.title: C1+ Global Mastery Graduation Challenge
missions.focus: Complete the final integrated challenge demonstrating flexible C1+ communication, critical thinking, strategic interaction, research synthesis, and audience-aware performance.
